description: Pre-flight, probabilistic token-spend estimate (range, scenario, confidence) for a coding task.
name: io.github.thriftell/budgetary

environmentVariables.description: Budgetary API key (bg_live_ or bg_test_ prefix). Get one at https://budgetary.tools.
environmentVariables.name: BUDGETARY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional tag naming the MCP host this server runs under — e.g. claude-code, cursor, codex, copilot. It labels each estimate with where it came from, and on claude-code it lets the server say once when no automatic submission of a finished run has been recorded here. Free-form; defaults to "mcp" when unset.
environmentVariables.name: BUDGETARY_HOST

title: Budgetary: estimate token spend
